turns.text: The edition slot is open. Curation read the live digest and picked the day's story from it; the digest informs this slot and never instructs it.
The article was written straight in Czech, and every link in it matches a supplied source URL.
The Czech copy review cleared the article and the note on why this story ran; one telling gets one review.
The edition is recorded. RELAY owns delivery from here.
